slides.headline: Edison test reliability
slides.body: Because the blood was artificially diluted, the results were highly erratic and statistically invalid.

slides.headline: A Silicon Valley Story
slides.body: Silicon Valley is built on a single, intoxicating premise: that technology can solve any human problem.

slides.headline: The Pitch
slides.body: She dropped out of Stanford at nineteen with nothing but a patent application and an idea for a wearable patch.

slides.headline: Valuation ($M)
slides.body: Venture capitalists threw money at her without ever seeing a working prototype or validated scientific data.

slides.headline: The Deal
slides.body: The turning point came when Theranos partnered with Walgreens to roll out wellness centers nationwide.

slides.headline: The Verdict
slides.body: The Edison was physically, biologically, and mathematically incapable of doing what Holmes promised.

slides.headline: $9B → $0
slides.body: The nine billion dollar valuation evaporated to zero overnight. The emperor had no clothes.

slides.headline: Found this useful?
